# Product Video Brief

## Product
Cordless stick vacuum shown in the provided product screenshot.

## Goal
Create a short vertical TikTok product video using only visible product elements from the screenshot.

## Visible Product Elements
- Purple-accent cordless stick vacuum body
- Circular digital display
- Long stick configuration
- Handheld configuration
- Slim crevice tool
- Brush attachment
- Filter components shown separately
- Battery / charging-style graphic shown separately

## Guardrails
- Do not claim suction power, runtime, filtration grade, or charging speed
- Do not invent certifications or performance numbers
- Keep the CTA generic

## Required Output
- 1080x1920 vertical MP4
- English on-screen copy
- Fast TikTok-style pacing
- No auto publishing
